revisions.feedbackText: APPROVE C41 TRACK-B SHAPE 2 — high-z mass–metallicity

changed.summary: Track-B study selected from the Step-6 map: Shape 2 (high-z MZR/FMR vs enrichment models) targeting axes A3 (calibration validity, 22 entries) and A4 (FMR/MZR survival at z>3, 14 entries), per their settle-lines: grow the z>3 Te-anchored set and re-test the deficit claims on matched samples; extend the single-methodology FMR design past z=3 anchored by the Te set.

Execution gate for the Shape-2 measurement: T1 catalog reconnaissance launched immediately (rules-first, verdict-independent); T2/T3 sequenced behind Kun's design refutation so patches fold in before the calibration contract and computations run.

Direction to draft the Shape-2 v1 result as a paper: the public-archive Te-anchor gap at z>3 — 5 contract-grade anchors from all of VizieR vs ~25 conservatively forecast, no mass bin reaching the pre-committed minimum, no deficit verdict possible at contract-grade public statistics; the quantified answer to map axis A3's settle-line.
